title: Commissioner Helgait
subtitle: Separatist
description: A former Separatist, Commissioner Helgait was not a fan of the new way the Empire -and later the New Republic- ran the galaxy. As the chief of security for Plazir-15, he organized his own rebellion against the status quo, ordering the nano-Droids that were placed into the malfunctioning Droids. He was sent off to live in exile on the moon of Paraqaat.
